contract.choice: First 100 accepted simulations in proposal order; no ascertainment by inferred signal.
contract.conditioning: Selected and neutral: 0 < whole-population frequency of the original introduced focal allele at present < 1

validation: 100 unique accepted simulations; verified score/tree/posterior/trajectory hashes, pair panel, 500-kb coordinate, selection schedule, exact AF and all thresholds.
comparison: Exact integer pair counts for truth/median; original continuous values for posterior mass.
recalibration: Selected CDFs, AF trajectories, IDs and proposal indices unchanged; only neutral comparison and p values replaced.
